name: figurestead-repository-checks
description: Pinned local tooling for Figurestead repository correctness checks; not a publishable package.

scripts.test:core: node web/test/core-smoke.mjs && node web/test/scientific-geometry.mjs && node web/test/readability-micro-polish.mjs && python3 audit/current-head-hardening/test_svg_serialization.py && node ci/check-playwright-notices.mjs
scripts.test:npm-release-integrity: node release/npm/test-candidate-verifier.mjs && node release/npm/verify-current-package.mjs && node release/npm/verify-all-candidates.mjs && node release/npm/check-publish-workflow.mjs
